newsitem.title: USA: Osicom, Data General expand pact.
newsitem.headline: Osicom, Data General expand pact.

text.p: Osicom Technologies said on Friday the RNS division of its owned Meret Communications unit had signed an amendment that expands its volume purchasing agreement with Data General Corp.

The company said in a statement that under the multi-year agreement, RNS will supply Data General with the RNS 2340-TX Multiport Fast Ethernet network interface adapters in addition to its CMC-130 VMEbus Ethernet adapters supplied under the previous agreement.
According to preliminary forecasts by Data General, the amendment to the agreement should yield more than $500,000 in extra revenues per year.

The RNS 2340-TX Multiport Fast Ethernet adapter provides PCI-based computers with four 10/100 megabits per second connections to the network. The CMC-130 is an intelligent Ethernet controller for VMEbus machines which frees the host computer from handling communications processing.
